name: com.testpreppilot/exam-catalog
title: TestPrepPilot exam catalogue
description: Read-only access to TestPrepPilot's published U.S. exam and certification catalogue: search guides, fetch every structured fact for one, list categories.

tools.name: search_exams
tools.title: Search exams
tools.description: Find published U.S. exam, licence and certification guides by keyword (name, acronym, awarding body, topic). Returns the best matches with fee and guide URL.

category.description: Optional category filter, exactly as returned by list_categories.

tools.name: get_exam
tools.title: Get exam facts
tools.description: Every structured fact for one guide: awarding body, fee, format, questions, length, pass mark, study time, salary range, topics, last-reviewed month, confidence and primary source URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: The credential categories in the catalogue, with the number of published guides in each.
